original.name: G8 — READY FOR PARTICIPANT 1
original.description: Final release gate. This card is the authoritative go/no-go for beginning data collection.

updatedCards.expectedDescription:
G8 coordination mirror. Requires evidence-backed authorized gate_passed event and human approval; checklist completion is not approval.

G8.01: The Unity study build (a tagged, versioned standalone build — never the Editor) runs a complete session: participant setup → per-participant calibration → practice → four condition blocks with breaks → session close, driven entirely from the operator screen.
G8.02: Both trackers are bound by serial number, report valid poses, and the trigger registers on the weapon tracker.
G8.03: Rig-level calibration (pivot, screen corners) is stored, and the daily bore-laser check (Appendix C.6) passes.
G8.04: Per-participant calibration flows (weapon zero, eye offset, 3×3 verification) run inside the application and write their results into the participant's data folder (Appendix A.5).
G8.05: The stimulus display renders head-coupled perspective correctly (corner-rod check passes from three viewing positions), and the operator view shows everything listed in briefing §6.6.
G8.06: Logging produces the full schema (Appendix B) at ~250 Hz with validity flags, plus events, plus a per-block target table, on one shared clock, with no dropped-sample warnings over a 30-minute soak.
G8.07: ELTS start/stop commands are sent for WE blocks only, acknowledged with timestamps, aligned to the shared clock, and the heartbeat fail-safe has been demonstrated (kill Unity → LEDs off within the configured timeout).
G8.08: All Phase 7 bench tests pass and are written up.
G8.09: At least three complete pilot sessions (non-data) have been run with the final build, and the analysis ingest script has successfully processed their output end to end.
G8.10: Every Decision Register (§15) item is closed, except D-15, which is informational only.

2026-09-06: no physical parts; no gate passed. Source: workbook Gate Criteria. Bootstrap incomplete.

original.name: AUTOMATION — Butler Rules to Enable
original.description:
This Trello connection cannot create Butler rules directly. Configure these in Board → Automation:

1) When all checklist items on a card are complete → mark card complete and move to Done.
2) When a card is moved to Done → mark it complete.
3) When a card is moved out of Done → mark it incomplete.
4) When a card is marked complete → move it to Done.
5) When a card is moved to Blocked / Waiting → keep it incomplete and move it to top of that list.
6) When a card is moved to In Progress → move it to top of In Progress.
7) Gate cards: when the gate checklist completes → mark gate complete and move to Done.
8) G8: when Ready for Participant 1 checklist completes → mark G8 complete and move to Done.

Do NOT auto-start the next phase; gates are go/no-go controls and phase work may run partially in parallel only where the build plan explicitly permits it.

updatedCards.expectedDescription:
Trello is a coordination mirror of the workbook baseline and, after bootstrap, validated repository events/PROJECT_STATE.json.

Do not enable rules that mark tasks or gates complete merely because a checklist is checked or a card is moved. In particular, remove any gate/G8 auto-completion rules suggested by the previous version of this card. Gate passage requires complete criterion evidence and explicit authorized gate_passed events with required human approval.

Permitted convenience rules: moving a card to In Progress or Blocked / Waiting may reposition it at the top of that list without changing completion. Done/completion must be reconciled only from validated authoritative task state; mixed tasks remain incomplete while required physical checks are outstanding. Do not auto-start phases.

2026-09-06 review corrected this guidance. The connector does not expose Butler rule inspection/configuration, so actual enabled automations were not verified or changed.
